description: List the events you host — name, date, status, visibility, location, capacity, headcount, category and community ids, plus the total count. See how many events you have, or find event ids before acting on them. Filters: status, upcoming_only, past_only, category, name_contains (e.g. a series name), starts_after / starts_before (ISO), community_id, last_n_past (the N most recent past events, newest first), limit. Requires a connected account. Read-only.
name: list_events
title: List Events
